title: Six hub tasks are called something different from what DR1 calls them, including 'Transporter' for what DR1 calls 'Transport details' and 'Uploaded documents' for what DR1 calls 'Upload documents'.

finding.frontend: The frontend's task labels (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub/copy/copy.en.js:26-79) read 'Main reason for importing', 'Additional commodity details', 'Animal identification details', 'Transporter', 'Contact address' and 'Uploaded documents'. Four tasks — 'Where is this consignment coming from?', 'What are you importing?', 'Arrival details' and 'Roles and addresses' — already match DR1, as does the conditional 'Transit countries' row.
finding.prototype: DR1 calls the same tasks 'Main reason for import', 'Additional details', 'Identification details', 'Transport details', 'Contact address for this consignment' and 'Upload documents' (app/routes.js:5751-5832). 'Upload documents' names the action rather than the result, and 'Contact address for this consignment' says whose contact address it is.
finding.difference: Rename the six tasks to DR1's wording. Copy on the hub only; the pages behind them keep their own headings, which are compared on their own screens. Whether the identification task should be visible at all, and whether commodity details should be a task of its own, are separate findings.
finding.falsifiedBy: A DR1 hub rendering any of these tasks under the frontend's wording.

relatedTo.why: same copy file, and the group captions differ for the same reason
